<h2>Resolve One Decomposition Fold Loss</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Internal helper that returns a loss only when one variant row matches.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>.resolve_decomposition_fold_loss(data_fold, variant_name)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_fold">data_fold</code></td>
<td>
<p>One route-repeat-fold data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="variant_name">variant_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Variant identifier to look up.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>One numeric loss or 'NA_real_' when the match is not unique.
</p>

</main>
